name: @sammons/typed-mind-monorepo
description: TypedMind - A domain-specific language for program architecture
author: sammons

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sammons/typed-mind run prebuild && pnpm run -r build
scripts.pretest: pnpm --filter @sammons/typed-mind run build && pnpm --filter @sammons/typed-mind-renderer run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run -r typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.build:bundled-all: pnpm run build:bundled && pnpm --dir lib/typed-mind-vscode-extension run bundle-lsp
scripts.check:browser-graph: pnpm --dir lib/typed-mind run build:browser && node scripts/check-browser-graph.mjs
scripts.validate: pnpm run check:workspace-scope && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:bundled-all && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:toolchain && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:bundled-wasm && pnpm run check:diagnostic-jargon && pnpm run check:diagnostic-code-audit && pnpm run check:fixture-audit-gating && pnpm run check:engines && pnpm run check:fix-orphans-deleted && pnpm run check:version-lockstep && pnpm run check:pack && pnpm run check:release-manifests && pnpm run check:browser-graph && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:golden-deltas && pnpm run check:clean-tree
scripts.validate:fix: pnpm run check:workspace-scope && pnpm run build && pnpm run build:bundled-all && pnpm run check:toolchain && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run check:bundled-wasm && pnpm run check:diagnostic-jargon && pnpm run check:diagnostic-code-audit && pnpm run check:fixture-audit-gating && pnpm run check:engines && pnpm run check:fix-orphans-deleted && pnpm run check:version-lockstep && pnpm run check:pack && pnpm run check:release-manifests && pnpm run check:browser-graph && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:golden-deltas
scripts.release: pnpm run validate && pnpm run check:release-manifests && pnpm -r --filter './lib/*' publish --access public
